manifest.title: Rotem Projects Full
manifest.author: Rotem Projects
manifest.description:
# Rotem Projects Full

Hebrew/RTL Vue 3 admin console **plus** Directus **11.17.4** **plus** a Laravel Directus-compatible API in one Cloudron app.

- **Admin UI** (SPA) at `/` — Directus URL locked to this origin; optional Laravel provider uses `/api`.
- **Directus Studio** at `/admin/`.
- **Directus API** on the same host (`/auth`, `/items`, `/assets`, …).
- **Laravel API** at `/api/*` (schema `laravel` in the same PostgreSQL database).
- PostgreSQL + Redis + mail + optional Cloudron SSO.
- Invoice-related Directus extensions are bundled.

Pinned Directus version: **11.17.4** (matches production).
manifest.changelog:
## 0.2.3

- nginx client/proxy temp paths under `/tmp/nginx` for read-only Cloudron root.
- Bundle `/app/lib`, full `invoice-pdf-download/runtime`, and `/src` helpers for app-guide-ai.
- Skip `artisan storage:link` (nginx aliases `/storage/`).

## 0.2.2

- Fix Directus bootstrap: ship `@napi-rs/snappy-linux-x64-gnu` (linux/amd64 image).

## 0.2.1

- Fix crash loop: bake `run-directus.sh` into the image (Cloudron `/app/pkg` is read-only at runtime).
- Skip runtime `.env` symlink under read-only `/app/code`.

## 0.2.0

- First **Laravel + Directus 11.17.4 + Vue SPA** Cloudron package.
- Based on `main` @ SPA `369a2ca` and Directus pin from `dev/directus`.
- SPA `DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudron` locks Directus to same origin; Laravel switcher stays available.

change-default-password.message: Change the default Directus admin password (admin@example.com / changeme)

apply-schema.message: Apply Rotem invoice schema (Bundle/Sync or compare-prod) after first Directus login

laravel-optional.message: Laravel compat API is at /api — switch provider on the login screen if needed

manifest.postInstallMessage:
## First login

1. Open the app URL — **Rotem Vue admin** (Directus base URL is this origin).
2. Default Directus admin (first boot only):
   - Email: `admin@example.com`
   - Password: `changeme`
3. Change that password in Directus Studio → `/admin/`.
4. Optional: on the login screen choose **Laravel** to use the compat API at `/api` (separate DB schema; seed via `cloudron exec` if needed).

## Schema & data

Directus boots empty (bootstrap only). Apply Rotem schema via Vue **Bundle / Sync** or repo scripts against this instance.

Laravel runs migrations on start into PostgreSQL schema `laravel`. Demo seed is optional (`php artisan db:seed` needs faker / `--with-dev` image or a custom seeder).

## Operator env

Edit `/app/data/env.sh` (Directus) and `/app/data/laravel.env` (Laravel extras), then restart.

manifest.changelog:
## 0.2.8

- First image that actually ships the 0.2.4/0.2.5 Laravel intake work (0.2.6/0.2.7 were the 0.2.3 tree + nginx fix):
  email (`/api/invoice-email/inbound`), Telegram, WhatsApp workers, `invoice_ai_jobs` LLM queue + health gate, `php8.3-imap`.
- Fix Laravel AI bridge in the image: ship `dev/directus/lib` + `src` helpers under `/app/code`, install `pdf-parse@1.1.1`
  (PDF text mode); build fails if `backend/scripts/aiBridge.js` cannot be imported.
- php-fpm `post_max_size=32M` / `upload_max_filesize=25M` (JSON email intake carries base64 PDFs).
- Supervisord `laravel-scheduler` (`schedule:work`) for `invoices:poll-email` and PDF download backfill.
- AI extraction prompt: Israeli dates are DD/MM/YYYY.
- start.sh: unset Directus-only env (CACHE_STORE=redis, KEY, OPENAI_* from env.sh, …) before Laravel so laravel.env wins and queue workers no longer crash with `Class "Redis" not found`.

manifest.postInstallMessage:
## First login

1. Open the app URL — **Rotem Vue admin** (Directus base URL is this origin).
2. Default Directus admin (first boot only):
   - Email: `admin@example.com`
   - Password: `changeme`
3. Change that password in Directus Studio → `/admin/`.
4. Optional: on the login screen choose **Laravel** to use the compat API at `/api` (separate DB schema; seed via `cloudron exec` if needed).

## Schema & data

Directus boots empty (bootstrap only). Apply Rotem schema via Vue **Bundle / Sync** or repo scripts against this instance.

Laravel runs migrations on start into PostgreSQL schema `laravel`. Demo seed is optional (`php artisan db:seed` needs faker / `--with-dev` image or a custom seeder).

## Operator env

Edit `/app/data/env.sh` (Directus) and `/app/data/laravel.env` (Laravel extras), then **restart the app** so `config:cache` rebuilds and supervised workers reload.

All invoice channels below are **Laravel-only**. Directus does not receive WhatsApp / Telegram / email natively. Prefer the **Laravel** backend in the SPA for status cards.

Configure Laravel AI (`OPENAI_*` / `INVOICE_AI_*`) before enabling any channel — workers download media then run AI extract. When the local LLM is down, jobs stay queued (health pause + re-dispatch); see `INVOICE_AI_QUEUE_*`.

### WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API)

1. In `/app/data/laravel.env`:

```env
WHATSAPP_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET=
WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN=
WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN=
WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=
WHATSAPP_ALLOWED_SENDERS=
WHATSAPP_PROJECT_ID=
WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION=v21.0
```

2. Callback: `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-whatsapp/webhook`  
   Stage: `https://adi-real-stage.maxd.pro/api/invoice-whatsapp/webhook`
3. Enable only after Meta verify, allowlist, project id, AI, and `laravel-whatsapp-worker` are ready.

### Email (webhook and/or IMAP)

No Meta tokens. Prefer a forwarder (Mailgun/n8n) → JSON webhook; optional IMAP poll when `php-imap` mailbox is configured.

```env
EMAIL_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
EMAIL_INVOICES_WEBHOOK_SECRET=          # ≥16 chars; Bearer or X-Email-Ingest-Secret
EMAIL_INVOICES_ALLOWED_SENDERS=         # emails and/or *@domain.com
EMAIL_INVOICES_PROJECT_ID=
# Optional IMAP:
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_HOST=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_PORT=993
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_USERNAME=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_PASSWORD=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_MAILBOX=INBOX
```

Inbound URL: `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-email/inbound`  
Worker: `laravel-email-worker`. IMAP: scheduled `invoices:poll-email` every 5 minutes when host is set (also runnable manually).

### Telegram Bot API

```env
TELEGRAM_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS=              # numeric chat ids, comma-separated
TELEGRAM_PROJECT_ID=
TELEGRAM_INVOICES_MODE=long_poll        # or webhook
# TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET=              # required for webhook mode (≥16)
```

Webhook (if mode=webhook): `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-telegram/webhook`  
Long-poll program: `laravel-telegram-poll`. Queue worker: `laravel-telegram-worker`.

### LLM queue (offline Mac / tunnel)

```env
INVOICE_AI_QUEUE_ENABLED=true
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://…/v1
OPENAI_API_KEY=
INVOICE_AI_MODEL=
# INVOICE_AI_JSON_MODE=false
# INVOICE_AI_PDF_MODE=text
```

Worker: `laravel-invoice-ai-worker` (ledger `invoice_ai_jobs`). Admin status: `GET /api/invoice-ai/queue-status`.

Restart the Cloudron app after env edits.

   - Password: `changeme`
3. Change that password in Directus Studio → `/admin/`.
4. Optional: on the login screen choose **Laravel** to use the compat API at `/api` (separate DB schema; seed via `cloudron exec` if needed).

## Schema & data

Directus boots empty (bootstrap only). Apply Rotem schema via Vue **Bundle / Sync** or repo scripts against this instance.

Laravel runs migrations on start into PostgreSQL schema `laravel`. Demo seed is optional (`php artisan db:seed` needs faker / `--with-dev` image or a custom seeder).

## Operator env

Edit `/app/data/env.sh` (Directus) and `/app/data/laravel.env` (Laravel extras), then **restart the app** so `config:cache` rebuilds and supervised workers reload.

All invoice channels below are **Laravel-only**. Directus does not receive WhatsApp / Telegram / email natively. Prefer the **Laravel** backend in the SPA for status cards.

Configure Laravel AI (`OPENAI_*` / `INVOICE_AI_*`) before enabling any channel — workers download media then run AI extract. When the local LLM is down, jobs stay queued (health pause + re-dispatch); see `INVOICE_AI_QUEUE_*`.

### WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API)

1. In `/app/data/laravel.env`:

```env
WHATSAPP_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET=
WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN=
WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN=
WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=
WHATSAPP_ALLOWED_SENDERS=
WHATSAPP_PROJECT_ID=
WHATSAPP_GRAPH_VERSION=v21.0
```

2. Callback: `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-whatsapp/webhook`  
   Stage: `https://adi-real-stage.maxd.pro/api/invoice-whatsapp/webhook`
3. Enable only after Meta verify, allowlist, project id, AI, and `laravel-whatsapp-worker` are ready.

### Email (webhook and/or IMAP)

No Meta tokens. Prefer a forwarder (Mailgun/n8n) → JSON webhook; optional IMAP poll when `php-imap` mailbox is configured.

```env
EMAIL_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
EMAIL_INVOICES_WEBHOOK_SECRET=          # ≥16 chars; Bearer or X-Email-Ingest-Secret
EMAIL_INVOICES_ALLOWED_SENDERS=         # emails and/or *@domain.com
EMAIL_INVOICES_PROJECT_ID=
# Optional IMAP:
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_HOST=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_PORT=993
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_USERNAME=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_PASSWORD=
# EMAIL_INVOICES_IMAP_MAILBOX=INBOX
```

Inbound URL: `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-email/inbound`  
Worker: `laravel-email-worker`. IMAP: scheduled `invoices:poll-email` every 5 minutes when host is set (also runnable manually).

### Telegram Bot API

```env
TELEGRAM_INVOICES_ENABLED=false
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS=              # numeric chat ids, comma-separated
TELEGRAM_PROJECT_ID=
TELEGRAM_INVOICES_MODE=long_poll        # or webhook
# TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET=              # required for webhook mode (≥16)
```

Webhook (if mode=webhook): `https://YOUR_APP_DOMAIN/api/invoice-telegram/webhook`  
Long-poll program: `laravel-telegram-poll`. Queue worker: `laravel-telegram-worker`.

### LLM queue (offline Mac / tunnel)

```env
INVOICE_AI_QUEUE_ENABLED=true
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://…/v1
OPENAI_API_KEY=
INVOICE_AI_MODEL=
# INVOICE_AI_JSON_MODE=false
# INVOICE_AI_PDF_MODE=text
```

Worker: `laravel-invoice-ai-worker` (ledger `invoice_ai_jobs`). Admin status: `GET /api/invoice-ai/queue-status`.

Restart the Cloudron app after env edits.


## SPA backend mode (optional)

Create `/app/data/spa.env` (no secrets) to control the Vue login provider chips:

```
SPA_BACKEND_MODE=laravel
```

Values: `both` (default — Directus + Laravel chips), `laravel` (Laravel only), `directus` (Directus only).
Restart the app after changing. Does **not** disable Directus Studio at `/admin`.


## Memory (1 GiB apps)

Package `memoryLimit` is 1 GiB. Defaults are tuned for that: few PHP-FPM children, capped Directus heap, lean queue workers.
If intake queues back up under load, raise the Cloudron memory slider (above 1 GiB requires a higher `memoryLimit` in a future package) or disable unused intake channels in `laravel.env`.

# Rotem Projects Full

Hebrew/RTL Vue 3 admin console **plus** Directus **11.17.4** **plus** a Laravel Directus-compatible API in one Cloudron app.

manifest.changelog:
## 0.2.12

- SPA: fix **כמות חשבוניות** in budget summary when grouping by חשבון להגשה / project (PR #232).
  Laravel `aggregate[count]=*` returns `count: { count: N }`; normalizer now reads nested count keys
  so invoice counts are non-zero while expense sums stay unchanged.
- Preference/auth: Laravel `/api/*` auth failures return JSON **401** even when the SPA omits
  `Accept: application/json` (detect via path, `expectsJson`/`wantsJson`, or `Content-Type: application/json`).
  Fixes SPA banner `Preference service unavailable (500)` on expired sessions.
- Base: 0.2.11 memoryLimit 1 GiB + 0.2.10 SPA_BACKEND_MODE + 0.2.9 Adi fixes + 0.2.8 intake.
